description: This file defines an abstract base class 'ApiTestBase' for setting up REST Assured configurations in Java-based API tests, including baseline URI, logging, mock mode, and HTTP client settings.

classes.name: ApiTestBase
classes.description: Abstract class providing setup for REST Assured testing with configuration for base URI, logging, mock mode, and HTTP client settings.

methods.name: configureRestAssured
methods.description: Static method annotated with @BeforeAll that configures REST Assured for API testing, setting base URI, logging, mock filters, and HTTP client parameters.
